Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Dushyant Mainali, Advocate for 
the petitioners.
Mr. P.C. Bisht, Addl. C.S.C. for the 
State.
Heard. 
Admit. 
Learned C.S.C. takes notice for the 
respondent nos. 1 to 3.
Respondents may file counter affidavit 
within four weeks.
Two weeks thereafter, rejoinder 
affidavit, if any, be filed. 
List this matter on 22.11.2023 along 
with WPSS No.698 of 2023.
Heard on Stay Application IA No.1 of 
2023.
Having considered the matter, this 
Court is of the view that no interim order 
shall be passed, unless the respondents are 
permitted to file their objections.
List on the date fixed.
In the meanwhile, respondents may 
file their objections. 
 (Ravindra Maithani J.) 
13.07.2023
